description: Fresh direct check of C-auto-leave-continuation, based on the explored real-node history. Start transfer between joint configuration application and its Advance; after bounded TimeoutNow loss and timeout, compare complete behavioral projections at the same phase of two successive ten-tick heartbeat cycles. Retain both projections and raw counters. Later unrelated proposal is a distinct rescue diagnostic.

harness.description: Serialized three-node RawNode driver with actual Ready persistence/application and actual peer traffic; read-only recursive state observer and explicit post-result rescue.
semantic_changes: No target code or protocol state mutations outside public API and required Storage writes.
Adds only read-only observation and a bounded transport loss policy for TimeoutNow.

legality.derivation: Three real RawNodes bootstrap identical voters and elect node 1 via actual vote traffic. Every Ready persists entries/HardState, applies committed configuration and then Advances; all messages arise from target output and are delivered in one FIFO queue. TransferLeader interleaves only after leader ApplyConfChange of the entering joint record and before Advance, preserving the suspected overlap. The sole loss policy drops TimeoutNow in a bounded prefix; after tick 10 every generated message is delivered. From ticks 20 to 30 the repeatable policy is Tick each node once then fully drain all Ready and traffic. No target fields or dependencies are replaced. The read-only projection traverses each RawNode including raft, log, MemoryStorage, progress/inflight buffers, term/roles, timers, pending queues, stepsOnAdvance and function code identities. It excludes only diagnostic logger fields, MemoryStorage call counters and its unlocked mutex. Every API call is serialized; there are no spawned workers or pending cleanup. A separately marked rescue proposal occurs after the primary result and is not evidence of autonomous continuation.
legality.applicability: Normal Ready/Advance; completed in-memory writes model durable success in a run without crashes; actual configuration effects are applied by the driver.
unresolved: Current semantic review must verify the state projection and source-based exclusion of entropy: only heartbeat traffic and stable roles in this suffix mean resetRandomizedElectionTimeout is not called.

grounding.derivation: Correlate result to one admitted configuration operation using operation_id; config_index is retained in the prerequisite and result and represents the observed committed entering record. The predicate excludes a fair closed idle cycle, not absence before a made-up deadline. State equality and the source of the periodic transition establish repeatability; no unrelated operation completion is assumed.
grounding.applicability: Only declared failed_transfer_idle scenario; rescue output is diagnostic.
unresolved: Correspondence review of exact projection and periodic suffix is required.
alternatives: A nonrepeating endpoint is not by itself a positive liveness proof.

observable_properties.description: No fully observed closed, drained, role-stable heartbeat/tick cycle may leave the admitted automatic exit pending after transfer clears. forbidden_idle_cycle is computed from exact structural equality of two live-state projections, drained queues/Ready work, only-heartbeat traffic, stable roles, no new application batches, pending AutoLeave and unchanged applied/committed/log tail. Failure is a finite cycle witness with source-based repeatability; false only means this specific witness was not found, not universal eventual completion.

uncertainties: The reflection observer intentionally excludes logger, unlocked mutex and call-count diagnostics; review must verify these are behaviorally inert for the captured serialized suffix.
Entropy is not compared globally; the observed stable-role heartbeat-only suffix must be shown not to consume election randomness.
This property finds a closed counterexample cycle; a false result would not prove the general eventual-progress obligation.
